svg.title: Voronoi cells with Euclidean and Manhattan distance
svg.desc: The same seven sites divided into cells twice. On the left, straight-line (Euclidean) distance gives convex polygons with straight edges at any angle. On the right, city-block (Manhattan) distance gives cells whose edges run only horizontally, vertically or at 45 degrees, so the cells take different shapes (drawn here from a fine grid of nearest-site tests).

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
